desc: Fetch base weights and compile them to TensorRT engines once; Triton loads the cached engines on every later start.
Stateless core routes: send an image, get normalized boxes, landmarks, 512-dim embeddings or text back.
Index images into OpenSearch for search, or into the curation item pool, where an item detector proposes crops.
Group crops by PE-Core embedding similarity and work active-learning review queues, most-uncertain first.
Label by hand or with an OpenAI-compatible VLM's suggestions; every write is undoable and keeps its provenance.
Freeze a test holdout and write a deterministic YOLO-format dataset with a checksummed manifest.
Preflight and launch a training run on the trainer container, then score it against baselines per class.
Serve the winning model from Triton; its predictions feed the next review cycle's disagreement queue.
